LanguageData.TMM.Walls.2.text: Damage values against buildings will be multiplied by these factors: \nSolid means impassable structures, typically walls.
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.3.label: Melee Sharp {SharpMeleePassable} [Default: 0.4]
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.4.label: Melee Sharp vs Solid {SharpMeleeImpassable} [Default: 0.1]
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.5.label: Blunt {BluntPassable} [Default: 0.5]
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.6.label: Blunt vs Solid {BluntImpassable} [Default: 0.3]
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.7.label: Ranged Sharp {SharpRangedPassable} [Default: 0.2]
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.8.label: Ranged Sharp vs Solid {SharpRangedImpassable} [Default: 0.2]
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.9.label: Explosion {BombPassable} [Default: 0.8]
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.10.label: Explosion vs Solid {BombImpassable} [Default: 1]
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.12.text: Melee Sharp: Cut, Poke, Stab, Scratch, Bite
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.16.text: "Bomb" is the only one of these which already had both factors, being 2 and 4, respectively
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.18.label: Revert Changes on Turrets/Hives/Chunks/Mech Cluster buildings?
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.18.tooltip: Disabling this will make the game harder, as you will have to constantly carry a breaching axe to break stuff, but your turrets will be stronger.
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.19.label: Natural stone resists ranged damage.
LanguageData.TMM.Walls.19.tooltip: Multiply ranged damage types against natural walls by zero.
